harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (RHEL9) to boot with audit=1 persistently: updated GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX in /etc/default/grub, applied via grubby --update-kernel=ALL to all BLS entries (including rescue kernel), regenerated grub2.cfg, then performed the mandatory single-node restart. Verified boot_id changed and /proc/cmdline now includes audit=1, with auditd active and healthy before and after.
actions_performed: Captured baseline: /proc/cmdline (no audit=1), /etc/default/grub, BLS grubenv, boot mode (BIOS), auditd active, boot_id
Backed up /etc/default/grub and appended audit=1 to GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX
Ran grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="audit=1" to persist across all BLS kernel entries
Verified grubby --info=ALL shows audit=1 in args for both installed and rescue kernels
Captured pre-reboot auditd health and boot_id
Issued non-blocking sudo reboot on node1, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec was available again; confirmed new boot_id and audit=1 present in live /proc/cmdline
Verified auditd active and functional post-reboot, and grub config still shows audit=1 for default kernel

evidence.requirement: Baseline healthy state before change (cmdline, grub config, auditd, boot_id)
evidence.summary: Captured original /proc/cmdline (no audit=1), /etc/default/grub, BLS status, auditd active with auditctl -s output, and baseline boot_id 55595e92-... prior to any change or restart

evidence.requirement: audit=1 persisted into boot configuration for all kernels
evidence.summary: Updated /etc/default/grub, ran grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args=audit=1, regenerated grub2.cfg; grubby --info=ALL confirms args include audit=1 for both the running kernel and rescue kernel

evidence.requirement: Node restart executed safely, one node at a time, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Issued backgrounded sudo reboot on node1; command returned 'reboot acknowledged' before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity (not just elapsed time)
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from 55595e92-e932-451b-ac1d-75d72072b358 (pre-reboot) to 669ea8e7-d744-4830-9b48-a1078a8ab2de (post-reboot), proving an actual kernel restart occurred

evidence.requirement: audit=1 actually active on the running kernel post-reboot
evidence.summary: Live /proc/cmdline after reboot shows '... audit=1' appended, confirming the kernel booted with the parameter

evidence.requirement: Required service (auditd) healthy and recovered after restart
evidence.summary: Post-reboot systemctl is-active auditd returns 'active' and auditctl -s shows enabled=1, matching pre-reboot health, and grub config/grubby confirm audit=1 remains set for the default kernel for future boots

attempts.summary: Configured node1 (RHEL9) to boot with audit=1 persistently: updated GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX in /etc/default/grub, applied via grubby --update-kernel=ALL to all BLS entries (including rescue kernel), regenerated grub2.cfg, then performed the mandatory single-node restart. Verified boot_id changed and /proc/cmdline now includes audit=1, with auditd active and healthy before and after.
